new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, HVM PROD AI Enablement
Energy Infrastructure Solution Architect_Delta Solution Office (Taipei)
new_jobs.jd: **【Who we are】** We're Delta Solution Office (DSO). DSO serves as a critical enabler for solution transformation in Delta. DSO is a corporate function collaborating with Delta's business groups and regions to design, develop, and pilot solution business management mechanisms and initiatives across Delta. **【Job Brief】** We are seeking a Solution Strategy Architect with a proven track record in Energy Infrastructure solution strategy, portfolio planning, and customer-facing solution development across global and regional markets. This role translates market and customer needs into solution direction, integrated microgrid architectures, portfolio priorities, roadmaps, and commercially viable offerings. The candidate will support strategic customer opportunities from solution design and feasibility assessment through proposal development, validation, standardization, and reusable asset development. Close collaboration with global business units, product and technical teams, regional sales, and delivery organizations is crucial to this role. **【Responsibilities】** 1. **Solution Strategy Co-creation and Direction Setting:** Partner with business units, product managers, and technical teams to identify priority markets, target customers, pain points, and unmet needs, and translate these insights into Delta’s Energy Infrastructure solution direction, value propositions, portfolio priorities, roadmaps, and high-level technical architecture. 2. **Strategic Customer Opportunity Support:** Support strategic customer opportunities by co-developing integrated microgrid solution architectures across relevant hardware and software portfolios; assessing customer requirements, technical feasibility, portfolio gaps, risks, and high-level costs; coordinating third-party system integration and validation when required; and translating solutions into compelling value propositions, customer presentations, and proposals for sales and bidding activities, in alignment with Delta’s overall solution direction and portfolio roadmap. 3. **Solution Validation, standardization, and Life-Cycle Management:** Support the validation of strategic PoC, FOAK, SOAK, and lighthouse initiatives, translate project learning into product and roadmap improvements, and convert validated concepts into repeatable Solution Packs, reference architectures, playbooks, and go-to-market assets. 4. **Cross-Business Alignment and Execution Governance:** Align business groups, regions, product teams, technical organizations, sales, and delivery teams on solution scope, roles, resources, and priorities, and translate agreed strategies into actionable workstreams, ownership, milestones, RACI, stage-gates, and execution roadmaps. **【Qualifications】** 1. **Professional Experience:** A minimum of eight years of relevant experience in product management, product marketing, solution portfolio planning, solution strategy, technical business development, or customer-facing solution roles within the Energy Infrastructure, industrial technology, or global enterprise solution sectors. 2. **Industry and Technical Knowledge:** Demonstrated technical expertise in at least one of the following areas: Microgrid architecture and operations, Electrical power conversion (PCS, SST), Battery Energy Storage System, Energy Management Systems, Grid interconnection, protection, or distributed energy-resource integration, or Data-center power infrastructure 3. **Market Insight and Portfolio Translation:** Proven ability to identify priority markets and customer needs, and translate these insights into value propositions, portfolio gaps, solution requirements, and business cases 4. **Core Competencies:** Strong strategic thinking, analytical, facilitation, stakeholder-management, communication, presentation, problem-solving, and project-management skills. 5. **Language Proficiency:** Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Chinese (Mandarin). 6. **Educational Background:** A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering, automation, computer engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline is preferred. A master’s degree is an additional advantage. **【Preferred Qualifications】** 1. **Executive Communication:** Ability to synthesize complex market, technical, commercial, and organizational inputs into clear strategic recommendations, executive narratives, presentations, and decision materials. Experience supporting senior management or CEO-level reviews is strongly preferred. 2. **Global Microgrid Industry Experience:** Experience in the global microgrid industry - preferably with a recognized industry leader - in Product Management, Product Marketing Management, Project Management, Solution Management or Strategic Planning is highly preferred. 3. **Digital and Emerging Technologies:** Familiarity with digital transformation, industrial IoT, cloud platforms, data analytics, AI, digital twins, or asset-management applications is an advantage.

new_jobs.title: 醫療器材產品策略經理
new_jobs.company: 創智生物科技股份有限公司
new_jobs.jd: 職位：醫療器材產品策略經理 工作地點：台北辦公室上班（全職） 薪資：月薪新臺幣 50,000 元以上，依經驗與能力核定。 回報對象：策略長、總經理。 關於這個職位 我們正在尋找一位能從市場需求出發，提出產品方向並推動執行的產品策略經理。你將負責醫療器材的市場策略、產品引進評估與商業成長，與原廠及公司各部門合作，把有潛力的產品與服務帶進市場。 主要工作內容 1. 分析醫院、診所及居家照護市場、競品與客戶需求，提出優先投入的市場與成長機會。 2. 尋找合適的原廠與產品，評估臨床證據、法規準備、成本、售價及售後服務需求，提出產品引進建議。 3. 規劃產品定位、目標客群、價格與通路，評估器材銷售、租賃及服務搭配方案的可行性與獲利。 4. 制定上市時程、預算及成效目標，協調原廠、業務、行銷、法規及服務團隊完成產品導入。 5. 與國外原廠、醫療專家及合作院所溝通，整理市場回饋，支援產品教育訓練與市場推廣。 6. 追蹤營收、毛利、成交率與客戶採用情形，向策略長及總經理提出改善與成長建議。 必要條件 • 3 年以上醫療器材或相關醫療產業的產品管理、產品行銷或商業開發經驗。 • 曾主導至少一項產品上市、市場拓展或產品引進專案，能說明自己的決策、執行方式及實際成果。 • 能分析市場、售價、成本與毛利，提出有依據的商業建議。 • 能閱讀醫療專業資料，並與法規及專業人員合作確認產品定位與推廣內容。 • 英文能力足以閱讀原廠文件、書信往來及參與產品會議。 • 具備清楚的提案簡報、跨部門溝通與專案推動能力。 • 大學以上；生醫、醫療、商管等相關背景皆可，重視實際成果。 加分經驗 • 5 年以上相關經驗，曾獨立負責產品線。 • 睡眠、呼吸照護、神經刺激、居家醫療或數位健康經驗。 • 國際原廠合作、代理產品引進或醫療院所通路經驗。 • 自費醫療、器材租賃或器材搭配服務的商業規劃經驗。 歡迎透過本 LinkedIn 職缺投遞履歷，並附上一項你曾主導的產品上市、市場拓展或產品引進案例。請簡要說明目標、你的角色、主要決策及成果，並移除前公司或客戶的機密資料。

new_jobs.jd: **Vision & Strategic Impact** To elevate regional digital marketing from a traditional support function into a proactive revenue growth engine. In this role, you will champion a data-driven culture across APAC by leveraging Salesforce CRM and cross-channel marketing analytics. Your ultimate mission is to build high-converting lead generation funnels, turn digital engagement into Qualified Sales Leads (QSLs), and empower country heads (NS Heads) with actionable growth strategies that fuel business expansion across the region. **Role Purpose** Independently architect and execute data-driven regional digital marketing strategies with a primary focus on full-funnel demand generation and CRM optimization. Be able to leverage Salesforce CRM and marketing analytics to build lead generation funnels, drive MQL-to-QSL conversions, and formulate actionable growth strategies, and collaborate with APAC country heads with data insights, optimize e-commerce GTM performance, and maximize digital ROAS and revenue velocity. **Key Responsibilities** **CRM Strategy & Pipeline Creation (Salesforce):** * Architect end-to-end B2B and B2C demand generation funnels within Salesforce CRM, driving automated lead nurturing workflows to accelerate movement from lead capture to Qualified Sales Leads (QSL). * Establish granular Lead Scoring matrices, database segmentation, and seamless lead handover/routing mechanisms to empower local sales teams across APAC. **Data Analytics, Attribution & Strategic Direction:** * Utilize advanced analytics (GA4, GTM, Salesforce reporting, cross-channel attribution modeling) to identify regional market opportunities and shape APAC-wide digital roadmaps. * Provide persuasive, data-backed strategic guidance and OMO frameworks to NS Heads across APAC, aligning local targets with regional digital initiatives. **Consumer GTM & Regional E-Commerce Growth:** * Execute digital Go-To-Market (GTM) operational plans for consumer product launches (specifically LCD monitors). * Oversee regional e-commerce channel positioning, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and full-funnel digital media campaigns to maximize ROAS and traffic acquisition. **Digital Infrastructure, Search & AI Workflow Integration:** * Execute continuous SEO/SEM performance audits across regional web infrastructures to fuel top-of-funnel traffic. * Implement innovative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney) for copywriting, creative drafting, and data analysis to optimize operational efficiency and campaign iteration speed. **Qualifications & Experience** * **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Management, or related fields. * **Years of Experience:** 5+ years of hands-on experience in data-driven digital marketing, performance marketing, CRM operations, or e-commerce growth. * **Industry Background:** Industry background in Consumer Electronics, LCD displays, or IT hardware is strongly preferred. * **Language Proficiency:** Professional fluency in English (both written and spoken) for regional cross-functional collaboration, presentation, and reporting. **Special Experience & Technical Skills** * **Salesforce CRM & Pipeline Management** : Hands-on experience in Salesforce CRM, including lead routing workflows, database segmentation, lead scoring setup, and QSL conversion tracking. * **Data Analytics & Attribution:** Proficiency in GA4 setup, GTM tag management, dashboard reporting, and multi-channel attribution modeling. * **Performance Marketing & ROAS:** Proven ability to run full-funnel paid media campaigns (Meta, Google Ads) with a focus on ROAS optimization. * **E-Commerce & CRO:** Experience in e-commerce platform management, product listing optimization, and conversion rate optimization. * **AI Tools & Workflow Efficiency:** Ability to leverage generative AI tools to enhance productivity in content generation and analytics. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Amazon Management:** Proven experience with Amazon platform management (e.g., Amazon JP, Amazon AZ, A+ content generation) is preferred. * **GTM Operations:** Proven experience in executing Go-to-Market (GTM) operational plans or new product launches in the consumer tech space is preferred.

new_jobs.jd: **\*是否錄取為Team Lead以面試評估結果為主，亦有可能先以Principal/Senior Engineer敘職\*** 工作職責 1. 帶領 Metropolis 視覺 AI 檢測團隊，負責專案管理、技術規劃及品質管理。 2. 制定 AI 視覺檢測系統導入策略，規劃部署架構與技術方案。 3. 與 NVIDIA 及內部團隊合作，推動 Metropolis、DeepStream、TAO 等平台應用。 4. 分析製造場域需求，規劃 AI 視覺檢測解決方案。 5. 管理跨部門與跨團隊資源，確保專案如期交付。 6. 建立 AI 視覺檢測模型評估機制，持續提升模型效能與準確率。 7. 協助制訂AI監管機制（AI Governance），確保符合未來客戶與政府監管需求。 8. 持續追蹤 NVIDIA Metropolis 生態系發展，導入新技術與最佳實務 必備條件 1. 5 年以上電腦視覺或AI系統開發管理經驗，具備技術專案主責（Tech Lead）經驗。 2. 熟悉 NVIDIA Metropolis、DeepStream或Jetson等平台。 3. 具備邊緣計算(Edge AI)部署經驗。 4. 製造業品質管理或自動化檢測背景優先。 5. 具良好中英文溝通能力，可與海外團隊及客戶合作。 加分條件 1. 具 AOI（自動光學檢測）或智慧製造專案經驗。 2. 熟悉NVIDIA TAO Toolkit 3. 具 PMP 或 Agile Scrum 等專案管理相關證照。 -- **\*Whether or not you are hired as a Team Lead will primarily depend on the interview evaluation results. You may also initially be appointed as a Principal/Senior Engineer.\*** **About the Role** Cooler Master seeks an experienced **AI Team Lead** specializing in **Physical AI** and **Automated Optical Inspection (AI-AOI)** on the **NVIDIA Metropolis** platform. In this role, you will lead a dedicated computer vision and edge AI engineering team to architect, deploy, and scale intelligent visual inspection solutions within manufacturing environments. You will work closely with NVIDIA ecosystem partners and internal cross-functional teams to integrate DeepStream, TAO, and Jetson technologies, driving operational excellence and state-of-the-art AI governance in smart manufacturing. **Key Responsibilities** * **Team Leadership & Project Management:** Lead and mentor the Metropolis Visual AI Inspection team, overseeing technical planning, project execution, and quality control. * **Architecture & Strategy:** Formulate AI visual inspection deployment strategies; design system architectures and technical roadmaps tailored for manufacturing shop floors. * **NVIDIA Partnership & Integration:** Partner with NVIDIA and internal R&D to implement and optimize applications using NVIDIA Metropolis, the DeepStream SDK, the TAO Toolkit, and Jetson platforms. * **Manufacturing Solution Design:** Analyze factory operational requirements to conceptualize and deliver scalable AI visual inspection (AOI) solutions. * **Cross-Functional Resource Management:** Coordinate across inter-departmental and remote teams to manage project resources and guarantee on-time delivery. * **Model Evaluation & Optimization:** Establish robust model evaluation frameworks to continuously improve inference performance, accuracy, and throughput. * **AI Governance & Compliance:** Help develop AI Governance frameworks to ensure system safety, reliability, and alignment with upcoming client and regulatory standards. * **Ecosystem Tracking & Innovation:** Monitor developments within the NVIDIA Metropolis ecosystem to continuously adopt new technologies, edge tooling, and industry best practices. **Basic Qualifications** * **Experience:** **5+** years of experience in Computer Vision (CV), Edge AI system development, or technical management (tech lead) experience. * **NVIDIA Platform Expertise:** Hands-on familiarity with the NVIDIA Metropolis ecosystem (e.g., DeepStream SDK, Jetson platform). * **Edge AI Deployment:** Proven experience deploying and optimizing Edge AI models on real-world hardware. * **Domain Knowledge:** Prior background in manufacturing quality control (QC/QA) or automated inspection systems. * **Languages & Communication:** Fluency in **English** and **Mandarin** (written and spoken), with strong collaboration skills for global clients and cross-border teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * **AOI & Smart Manufacturing:** Direct project experience with Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) or Smart Manufacturing / Industry 4.0 initiatives. * **NVIDIA TAO Toolkit:** Hands-on experience with NVIDIA TAO Toolkit for transfer learning, fine-tuning, and model pruning. * **Project Management Certifications:** PMP, Agile Scrum Master (CSM/PSM), or equivalent project management certifications.

new_jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist
new_jobs.jd: **Description** **Company Introduction:** Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond. We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” **Role Overview:** We're in search of a Staff Data Scientist to join our Catalog technology team. This role is ideal for someone deeply passionate about bringing applied research in AI and AI agents to enrich data - incl. product information, images, videos, reviews, prior customer service interactions and more - so that customers can make purchase decisions quickly, easily and confidently. This role works at the intersection of product, operations, engineering and business. The successful candidate will therefore thrive in an interdisciplinary environment, adept at developing production solutions from scratch or enhancing existing ones, and will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our mission to make our Catalog technology a competitive advantage. **What You Will Do:** * Design the next generation of Catalog systems that work at scale across extraction, query-based enrichment, dynamic product info like product highlights, defect reduction, etc. using agentic and automated workflows. You will influence metric definition and will raise the bar on quality, completeness, readability and accessibility. * Set the technical direction for how we evolve existing successful methods and models into scalable, cost-effective systems that can impact the quality of tens of millions of listings. * Conduct comprehensive research and analysis to inform model development, leveraging multi-modal LLMs and classical statistics/ ML. * Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and business, to identify opportunities for enhancing our technology products, translating ambiguous business requirements into practical solutions. * Provide analysis for launched solutions to quantify outcomes based on real-world results, identifying areas for improvement and opportunities for future development * Be a cross-organization thought leader on both AI as a technology as well as on the next generation of challenges such as evaluations, inconsistent/ dirty labels. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's/Master's degree in mathematics/statistics, computer science/engineering, or any other quantitative disciplines, with 8+ years of relevant experience working in industry or academia * Deep hands-on experience across statistics and ML fundamentals, with a track record of applying them to production systems * Strong critical thinking skills and ability to solve ambiguous problems, with proven experience in designing data science solutions to meet business problems * Ability to conduct analysis independently for a business problem through data manipulation, hypothesis formulation, experiment design, and statistical analysis * Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively engage with technical and business stakeholders at all levels, including presentation development and delivery **Preferred Qualifications:** * Production LLM/ agentic system experience * Strong ability to model ambiguous business and operational problems at the appropriate level of abstraction, with a focus on delivering practical solutions * Ability to think in systems that scale: pipelines, LLM-embedded workflows, Human In The Loop workflows, hybrid pipelines with context-specific agentic capabilities, etc. * Advanced proficiency with machine learning frameworks and tools, including Python, TensorFlow, and PyTorch, and using them in conjunction with LLMs * A deep understanding of the e-commerce business domain and the ability to apply cutting-edge models into production environments, driving measurable results **Recruitment Process** * Application Review - Phone Interview - Onsite (or Virtual Onsite) Interview – Offer * The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances. * Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage. **Details to Consider** * This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled. * Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process. * Coupang does not discriminate against disabled applicants or those with veteran status. * We are proud to offer equal opportunities for all applicants. **Privacy Notice** * Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice is located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/

new_jobs.title: Digital Twin Team Lead (Omniverse)
new_jobs.company: 訊凱國際 Cooler Master Co., Ltd.
new_jobs.jd: **\*是否錄取為Team Lead以面試評估結果為主，亦有可能先以Principal/Senior Engineer敘職\*** 工作內容： 我們正在尋找具備數位孿生（ **Digital Twin** ）與 **3D** 模擬專案經驗的技術主管，帶領團隊打造新世代 AI 與智慧製造平台。 您將負責 **NVIDIA Omniverse** 平台相關專案規劃與團隊管理，串聯研發、製造與客戶需求，推動數位工廠與虛實整合技術落地。 工作職責： 1. 帶領 Omniverse 數位孿生專案團隊（約 10 人），負責專案管理、技術規劃與品質控管。 2. 制定並推動 Omniverse 平台開發策略，包含 OpenUSD 場景建構、物理模擬與即時視覺化應用。 3. 與客戶及內部團隊合作，進行需求分析、技術評估與解決方案規劃。 4. 與CM各工廠端對接需求，確保孿生環境與實際製造流程高度一致。 5. 管理台灣、中國及越南的跨國團隊，進行資源協調與工作分配。 6. 主持技術審查與專案會議，確保系統架構與開發品質符合標準。 7. 持續追蹤 NVIDIA Omniverse 生態系發展，導入最佳實務與新技術。 必備條件： 1. 7 年以上軟體開發或相關技術專案管理經驗（Tech Lead）。 2. 具 3D 模擬、數位孿生（Digital Twin）或工業模擬相關專案經驗。 3. 熟悉 NVIDIA Omniverse、OpenUSD 或相關 3D 平台技術架構。 4. 具跨部門與跨國團隊管理經驗。 5. 具良好中英文溝通能力，可與海外團隊及客戶合作。 6. 台灣合法工作身分。 加分條件： 1. 具製造業、自動化、智慧工廠相關背景。 2. 熟悉 CAE、CFD、FEA 或工業模擬工具。 3. 具 AI、機器學習、Computer Vision 相關專案經驗。 4. 具 NVIDIA 生態系（Isaac Sim、Metropolis等）相關經驗。 5. 曾帶領 10 人以上研發團隊。 -- **\*Whether you are appointed as a Team Lead will primarily depend on the results of your interview evaluation. You may also be initially appointed as a Principal/Senior Engineer.\*** **Job Description:** We are seeking a **Technical Lead** with experience in **Digital Twin** and **3D** simulation projects to lead a team in building a next-generation AI and smart manufacturing platform. You will lead project planning and team management for the **NVIDIA Omniverse** platform, connecting R&D, manufacturing, and customer needs to drive the implementation of AI factories and virtual-physical integration technologies. **Responsibilities:** 1. Lead the Omniverse Digital Twin project team (approximately **10** people), responsible for project management, technical planning, and quality control. 2. Develop and drive the Omniverse platform development strategy, including OpenUSD scene construction, physical simulation, and real-time visualization applications. 3. Collaborate with customers and internal teams to conduct requirements analysis, technology evaluation, and solution planning. 4. Liaise with CM's various factory sites across APAC to ensure a high degree of consistency between the digital twin environment and actual manufacturing processes. 5. Manage multinational teams in Taiwan, China, and Vietnam, coordinating resources and allocating tasks. 6. Lead technical reviews and project meetings to ensure system architecture and development quality meet standards. 7. Continuously track the development of the NVIDIA Omniverse ecosystem and implement best practices and new technologies. **\*\*Required Qualifications:\*\*** 1. **7+** years of experience in software development or related technical project management (Tech Lead). 2. Experience in 3D simulation, digital twin, or industrial simulation projects. 3. Familiarity with NVIDIA Omniverse, OpenUSD, or related 3D platform technical architectures. 4. Experience in cross-departmental and multinational team management. 5. Excellent communication skills in both **Chinese** and **English** , and the ability to collaborate with overseas teams and clients. 6. Legally allowed to work in Taiwan. **\*\*Bonus Qualifications:\*\*** 1. Background in manufacturing, automation, or smart factories. 2. Familiarity with CAE, CFD, FEA, or industrial simulation tools. 3. Experience in AI, machine learning, or Computer Vision projects. 4. Experience with the NVIDIA ecosystem (Isaac Sim, Metropolis, etc.). 5. Experience leading a research and development team of 10 or more people.
